name: @agent-local/postgres
description: Standalone local Postgres (pgvector) + pgAdmin (deploy + provisioning workspace): postgres with our config baked into the image, pgAdmin preconfigured, and an idempotent provisioner (roles/users/schemas/tables via dbup). Not part of the app lifecycle — own start/stop scripts.

scripts.healthcheck: docker exec agent-local-postgres pg_isready -U agent -d agentlocal
scripts.psql: docker exec -it agent-local-postgres psql -U agent -d agentlocal
